name: pumi-stacks
description: Stacked columns in one sideways scroll, in the default theme's look: every tab of the session is a column, and the ones scrolled past fold into spines.

column_width.label: Column width
column_width.desc: How wide a new column is, in terminal characters. Drag a column's right edge to size that one.

focus_follows_mouse.label: Focus the column under the mouse
focus_follows_mouse.desc: A column takes the focus as the mouse moves onto it, without a click.

haptics.label: Haptic feedback
haptics.desc: A tap on a Force Touch trackpad as a switch turns or a slider steps. Nothing on a mouse.
